name: Blueberry Lane Farms
tagline: This Michigan blueberry farm has berries that ‘don’t exist anywhere else in the world’
description: Blueberry Lane Farms is an on-farm market in 13240 Blueberry Lane, MI, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
